combat_history.event: Routinely operated on patrols over the East and South China Seas and around Taiwan, often coordinating fighter incursions.
combat_history.significance: Demonstrates its role as the airborne C2 node of PLA operations.

modernization.description: Carrier-capable AEW aircraft for the Fujian, analogous to the U.S. E-2 Hawkeye.
modernization.impact: Extends AEW coverage to PLAN carrier groups.

vulnerabilities.description: Large, non-stealthy, vital enabler — a priority target for long-range AAMs.
vulnerabilities.context: Weapons like the PL-17 and AIM-174 are built to kill such aircraft.
vulnerabilities.mitigation: Operated behind fighter screens and IADS.

vulnerabilities.description: Few aircraft can sustain continuous coverage of a large area.
vulnerabilities.context: Attrition or maintenance gaps create blind spots.

operational_patterns.typical_deployment: Stand-off orbits providing radar coverage and command of fighters/weapons over contested seas.
operational_patterns.typical_task_group: Cues J-20/J-16 fighters and anti-ship missiles; behind IADS protection.
operational_patterns.readiness_notes: Substantial fleet across PLAAF and PLAN.

peer_comparisons.key_differences: The E-7 is the modern Western AEW&C standard; the KJ-500 is China's fixed-AESA equivalent.
peer_comparisons.video_angle: The flying radars that run the air war.

peer_comparisons.key_differences: The carrier KJ-600 is China's answer to the venerable E-2.
The KJ-500 cues the J-20's long-range missile shots — the two operate as a team.
peer_comparisons.video_angle: How China's stealth kill chain works.

doctrine.role: Airborne early-warning and control aircraft — the radar and command node of the PLA kill chain.
doctrine.employment: Stand-off orbits detect and track targets and direct fighters and missiles onto them.
doctrine.design_philosophy: Fixed-AESA 360-degree coverage on a reliable transport airframe.
doctrine.threat_context: Cues J-20 and anti-ship missile shots; a top enabler target for both sides.
doctrine.comparison_frame: Read against the E-7 Wedgetail and E-2 Hawkeye, and as the J-20's teammate.
